title: PerceiveImagine
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from an experiment in which participants alternately perceived and imagined visual images based on auditory prompts. Each trial consisted of a 6-second perception phase, during which participants viewed an image, followed by a 6-second imagination phase with eyes closed. The dataset is intended to support research on EEG-based analysis of perception and mental imagery processes, such as deep learning approaches to EEG decoding.
methods_description: Participants perceived an image for 6 seconds based on a prompt, then closed their eyes and imagined the image for 6 seconds based on the prompt. After hearing a prompt sound, they proceeded to the next trial.
